reviews.body: Thanks for updating these recommendations. The Google change is current, but the Anthropic model ID needs one small correction before this can land.

Both suggested models check out (details in the doctor.go thread), the doctor tests pass, and CI is green. The one leftover retired-model mention is the `claude-3-sonnet` example in the Python `AIConfig.model` description, which is out of scope here.

review_comments.body: `claude-sonnet-5-5` is not a published Anthropic API model ID. Please switch this to `claude-sonnet-5` and update the matching test/template text so `af doctor` suggests a model users can call.

Thanks for checking this. I believe `claude-sonnet-5-5` is a published API model ID: it is listed as the Claude API ID and alias for Claude Sonnet 5.5 in the [Models overview](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview), and the [Model deprecations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations) page lists it as Active and as the recommended replacement for `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` (retiring November 30, 2026).

`claude-sonnet-5` is also still listed as active, so if you would rather `af doctor` suggest that one, I'm happy to switch it and update the matching test/template text. Just let me know which you prefer.

This reply was drafted with the assistance of an AI coding agent (Claude).

Checked this one. `claude-sonnet-5-5` is the published ID for Claude Sonnet 5.5, the current Sonnet, and `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022` was retired on 2025-10-28, so the value in the PR is right as written. `gemini-3.8-flash` is also listed as stable on Google's models page with no shutdown date. Resolving this and re-requesting your review.
